calls.statement:
SELECT o.status, o.fulfilment_type, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT o.web_order_id) dn, min(o.order_ts_utc), max(o.order_ts_utc)
FROM fact_web_order o
WHERE CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) = DATE '2025-12-01'
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

calls.statement:
SELECT o.web_order_id, o.status, o.order_ts_utc, o.line_count, count(f.sales_line_id) lines, count(*) FILTER (WHERE p.category='ZZ Test') testlines, count(*) FILTER (WHERE s.store_id=999) st999
FROM fact_web_order o
LEFT JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.receipt_id=o.web_order_id
LEFT JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
LEFT JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
WHERE CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) = DATE '2025-12-01'
GROUP BY ALL
HAVING count(*) FILTER (WHERE p.category='ZZ Test')>0 OR count(*) FILTER (WHERE s.store_id=999)>0 OR count(f.sales_line_id)<>o.line_count

SELECT COUNT(*) AS web_orders, COUNT(DISTINCT web_order_id) AS distinct_orders
FROM fact_web_order o
WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled'
  AND CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) = DATE '2025-12-01'
